page_title: HEI 1-3 WOL | Heidenheim v Wolfsburg 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Total attempts – 18:13.
90+2' The attendance is 15000.
90+1' Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Harm Osmers pulls out a yellow card.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' 1 - 3 Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
89' A brilliant cross into the box finds Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
89' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
87' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim) replacing Marvin Pieringer.
87' Substitution. Leo Scienza will be replaced by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim).
84' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) gets a yellow card. The referee Harm Osmers made the right call.
83' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
82' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
81' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
80' Substitution. Kilian Fischer is replaced by Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
80' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Bence Dardai will be replaced by Salih Ozcan (Wolfsburg).
78' A cross from Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
78' The referee Harm Osmers awards Kamil Grabara (Wolfsburg) a yellow card.
77' Paul Wanner will be replaced by Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim).
74' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) sees a yellow card from Harm Osmers after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
74' The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.
71' Mohamed Amoura goes off the pitch and Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) comes on.
71' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Patrick Wimmer and he is replaced by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
70' Harm Osmers has issued a yellow card to Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg).
66' One of the players from Heidenheim times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
64' 1 - 2 Goal! Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 1:2.
64' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
63' The Heidenheim players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
59' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:4.
57' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Jonas Fohrenbach is replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
57' It's time for a substitution. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) comes on in place of Niklas Dorsch.
56' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
56' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.

53' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Harm Osmers with no other option than to blow for a foul.
53' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Heidenheim was in an offside position.
51' A long ball forward to Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) is intercepted.
50' A pass from Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by Kevin Muller and the move breaks down.
49' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) wins the ball from the resulting free kick but scuffs his shot well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
48' A yellow card for a tackle by Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg). Harm Osmers doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
48' Kevin Muller displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
46' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Harm Osmers blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) for a tough tackle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' 0 - 2 After a scramble inside the penalty area the ball falls to Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) who unleashes a weak but precise shot which goes in off the left post.
41' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
40' A superb shot by Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
40' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Harm Osmers has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
38' Harm Osmers blows his whistle after Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
37' 0:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
35' The corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared away by the defence.
35' What a strike! Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) hits the left post from the free kick.

34' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.

29' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
27' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Heidenheim players look gutted.
26' The Heidenheim players halt their celebrations as referee Harm Osmers makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
25' Goal! Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 1:1.
25' Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
24' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Heidenheim will take a corner kick.
23' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
23' Corner kick. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
23' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity.
20' Joakim Maehle is being substituted because of an injury. Ralph Hasenhuttl sends Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) on the pitch.
20' The ball possession at the moment is 60:40.
17' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Harm Osmers interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
16' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
14' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Kevin Muller.
13' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
11' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
9' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
7' Heidenheim are ruled offside.
6' Harm Osmers has a clear sight and sees a foul from Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg).
5' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
3' 0 - 1 Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) collected a superb pass and fired a terrific shot into the bottom left corner off the goalpost. Wonderful piece of finishing!
3' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' The first half has just begun.
Heidenheim will kick-off.
Harm Osmers will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
